title: Preliminary report: Microsoft attributes a major 365 and Exchange outage to a software defect introduced in a July 2026 update for network gateway servers (Richard Speed/The Register)
summary: Richard Speed / The Register: Preliminary report: Microsoft attributes a major 365 and Exchange outage to a software defect introduced in a July 2026 update for network gateway servers — Microsoft has blamed last week's epic outage on a change it made in July that lurked in the network gateway servers until a surge …
